attempt.message: This file has been identified as malware or spam and cannot be downloaded.

interpretation: The provider blocked the requested download. No file bytes were received or read. The provider flag is not independent verification that this specific PDF contains malware or spam.
next_action: Owner/provider review or an accessible replacement is needed before this file can be read. No abuse override, private credential or alternate download endpoint was attempted. The blocked file remains unfinished; continue with the next unattempted file.
